dedupe_keys.name: flights and passengers from london airports

description: Flights and Passengers from London Airports is a dataset listed in London Datastore, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Civil Aviation Authority (CAA). UK Airport Statistics are available each month from the Civil Aviation Authority. Table shows number of passengers handled by each London airport, and the country of destination of each passenger arriving into or departing from London's airports in the whole of 2011. Coverage: Civil Aviation Authority (CAA). The publisher named on the listing is Civil Aviation Authority (CAA). Its keywords include flights, visitors, passengers, planes, airports. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence v2. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-london-datastore.
